patches.detail: builder pin moved from specific-web-variant-selection.v10.json (901cd88f) to .v11.json (3e222bac), both the literal path and the pinned sha

webCandidateDedupe (added in the ninth batch) read only the base receipt <article>.<sha>.json, so a candidate whose effective receipt is a bound retry of a voided/failed call was reported as superseded-failed with no effective version. It now mirrors textbook-audit-web.mjs latestWebAuditReceipt: a .retry- receipt supersedes the prior one only when retry.retryOfAudit binds the immediately prior receipt (normalised path + sha) and the prior status is failed. Each version row additionally records effectiveReceiptPath and receiptChainLength.
patches.reason: 199-1/chapter03-section013.rev1 is passed only through such a retry; the first build of this batch staged it correctly (explicit selection + live gate) but the receipt's own dedupe inventory contradicted that, reporting no effective passed version for the article.
patches.stagingImpact: none: webCandidateDedupe is reporting only. selected/ staged articles come from the flat scan ranking plus the explicit selection manifests, both unchanged by this patch.

builds.note: same content as the delivered build but produced by the builder before the dedupe-retry fix, so its receipt reported chapter03-section013 as having no effective passed version. Left on disk untouched; not referenced by any pointer.
